title: zveltio.view/2
description: An extension's view (ADR 0042): what a screen shows, bound by name to the extension's collections and actions. Each front end draws it in its own way.

actions.description: Toolbar actions of this view; a detail's act on the record it shows (`$record`).

fallback.description: What a front end that does not know this view kind draws instead.

edit.description: Offer each row's form, to change it.

ActionName.description: One of this extension's actions, or `<dependency>.<action>` for a dependency's (ADR 0014).

ViewId.description: The id of a view, e.g. `mail.compose`.

PaneId.description: The id of a view inside a container; `$selected` names it.

Text.description: A message key of the extension, or literal text.

Tone.description: A semantic tone; each front end picks its colours.

Ref.description: A value the front end fills in. Nothing else is computed in a view.

anyOf.description: A field of the current record.
The id of the record selected in a pane.
A field of every selected record (bulk actions).
A parameter the view was opened with.

Input.description: An action's input, or a view's parameters, by name.

Condition.description: A data API condition on one field; its value is shaped by the operator.

anyOf.description: Compares the field with a value.
The field is (not) one of a list.

Sort.description: A field, or several; `-field` sorts descending.

Field.description: A field by name; its type, label and editor come from the collection.

fallback.description: The field shown instead while this one is empty.

Change.description: `patch` writes the record through the data API; or an action does it.

busyWhen.description: While the record meets these, the work the action started is under way: the button is busy, and the front end reads the record again until it no longer does.

FileHandoff.description: Stored files the caller hands the action's job (`$files`, ADR 0032).

read.description: File ids the job may read, or a `file` field's value (its files' ids).

write.description: The one file the job may store.

ActionResult.description: What an action returns, as a front end reads it (ADR 0042 decision 4). An object with `view`, `file` or `reveal` is one of the closed forms; anything else is values.

params.description: The parameters it is opened with (`$param`).

anyOf.description: Hands the caller a stored file.
Shows a value once (a key, a secret).

ActionValues.description: Values: a scalar, a list, or an object without `view`, `file` or `reveal` (a form `recalc` merges an object of them).
